name: audit-real-client-smoke-ci
title: Run real kubectl/Helm smokes in CI and bump advertised K8s version
description: Install checksum-pinned kubectl v1.36.2 and Helm v4.2.0 in the full CI lane, run the existing real-client smokes, and advertise Kubernetes v1.36.2 from one source constant.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Implementation pins verified from official release endpoints on 2026-07-20: kubectl v1.36.2 and Helm v4.2.0. The facade advertises v1.36.2, and the CI contract guard owns each pin, checksum-to-artifact binding, serial smoke, and selector anchor. GitHub Actions run 29801400915 light job 88543062073 installed both clients and the dedicated smoke step passed both tests in 5.80 seconds on 2026-07-21.
